_help: alerts = tickers shown on the Alerts page. watchlist = tickers shown on the Watch List page (Tel Aviv shares end with .TA, the rest are shown as 'abroad'). unlisted = companies with no market price that I could not find trading. A ticker can be a plain text like "NVDA" or {"symbol": "LUMI.TA", "name": "Hebrew name"}. Keep the commas and quotes. For unlisted companies, 'query' is the news search text (Google News).
